purpose: Quantify post-ERV EO energy and transport for the ideal inverse-design membrane while varying only water diffusivity from the numerical zero limit and 1e-14 to 1e-9 m2/s.
interpretation: Workshop sensitivity study. The membrane vector is hypothetical, receiver/sink energy remains parameterized, and positive rows are conditional model results rather than validated system savings.

targets.label: O50 reference at 32 C
targets.interpretation: The passive ERV outlet is already drier than O50 on an absolute-humidity basis, so post-ERV EO has no O50 duty.

targets.label: 10 percent post-ERV humidity-ratio reduction
targets.interpretation: Historical post-ERV polishing coordinate; it completes 22.1925 percent of the finite remaining latent duty.

targets.label: O30 humidity ratio at 32 C
targets.interpretation: EO polishing from the passive ERV outlet to the O30 absolute-humidity coordinate.

targets.label: Full remaining latent duty
targets.interpretation: EO removes all remaining post-ERV moisture to the 20 C, 50 percent RH supply humidity ratio; the screening coil then carries sensible load only.

endpoint_control_audit.interpretation: Retains the exact-endpoint versus near-endpoint coil-control discontinuity audit.

transport_sweep.receiver_capacity_axis_interpretation: Balanced process/exhaust only; no external receiver-air source is introduced in this workshop sweep.
transport_sweep.external_receiver_source_interpretation: Not used: receiver-to-process dry-air ratio is fixed at one.
transport_sweep.current_density_policy: sampling coordinate only; no acceptance cap
